In plain English

Overnight the pound climbed from 1.30938 to 1.31312 and is now 1.31255, above today's open price 1.31186. The dollar has been falling since Monday and is resting on a weekly support zone.

When a move like that pauses, the best buy is usually on the way back down, around two-thirds of the way into the move: 1.31028 to 1.31089. We wait for London to dip there and for a 5-minute candle to close back above 1.31089. If a 15-minute candle closes below 1.31028, the idea is wrong and we stand aside. It is a US half-day, so moves may be small.
